########################################################################
include(GrPlatform) #define LIB_SUFFIX
list(APPEND sfcwRadar_sources
    bladerfRadarMIMO_impl.cc
    bladerfRadarController_cc_impl.cc)

set(sfcwRadar_sources
    "${sfcwRadar_sources}"
    PARENT_SCOPE)
if(NOT sfcwRadar_sources)
    message(STATUS "No C++ sources... skipping lib/")
    return()
endif(NOT sfcwRadar_sources)

add_library(gnuradio-sfcwRadar SHARED ${sfcwRadar_sources})
target_link_libraries(gnuradio-sfcwRadar gnuradio::gnuradio-runtime bladeRF)
target_include_directories(
    gnuradio-sfcwRadar
    PUBLIC $<BUILD_INTERFACE:${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../include>
    PUBLIC $<INSTALL_INTERFACE:include>)
set_target_properties(gnuradio-sfcwRadar PROPERTIES DEFINE_SYMBOL "gnuradio_sfcwRadar_EXPORTS")

if(APPLE)
    set_target_properties(gnuradio-sfcwRadar PROPERTIES INSTALL_NAME_DIR
                                                    "${CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX}/lib")
endif(APPLE)

########################################################################
# Install built library files
########################################################################
include(GrMiscUtils)
gr_library_foo(gnuradio-sfcwRadar)

########################################################################
# Print summary
########################################################################
message(STATUS "Using install prefix: ${CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX}")
message(STATUS "Building for version: ${VERSION} / ${LIBVER}")

########################################################################
